comment: The example photos of Examples/Cutout. tools/fetch_examples.sh downloads each one from `url`, checks its size in bytes and its sha256, and writes it to Examples/Cutout/Examples/<file>; the app bundles the photos from there (the ids and files CutoutModel.examples names). The repository holds no images, so this file and the script are the record. `lighthouse` and `chess` are Examples/Look's `scene` and `object` (CC0 1.0 by their Openverse records); `airplane` is a NASA photo (public domain: NASA images are not copyrighted in the United States; NASA asks that it not be used to imply its endorsement). None shows a person, a brand or a logo. `format`, `width`, `height`, `bytes` and `sha256` describe the file exactly as the URL serves it (no re-encode). `words` is what the app puts in the box when the photo is tapped.

examples.shows: a white lighthouse with a red base and a brown roof on rocks by the sea, dune grass in front, clear blue sky
examples.creator: Bonnie Moreland (free images)

examples.shows: light wooden chess pieces (a queen, a king, bishops and pawns) on a worn wooden chessboard, close up; dark pieces out of focus behind
examples.creator: Kristin Hardwick

examples.shows: NASA's Super Guppy cargo airplane approaching a runway over scrub and trees, seen from the front under a grey sky
examples.title: Guppy Arrival for Orion EM-1 Crew Module Structural Test Article (Kennedy Space Center, 2017)
examples.creator: NASA
